name: Tivoli Gardens
desc: The 1843 amusement park that inspired Disney, with better lighting. Entry stings, but the evening glow is noodles-for-a-week worthy.

name: Nyhavn
desc: The candy-colored harbor from every screensaver. Skip the quayside menus, grab something cheap, sit on the edge like a local.

name: The Little Mermaid
desc: She's small, she's mobbed, she's free. Go at 7am and you and the bronze girl can be quietly wistful together.

name: Rosenborg Castle
desc: A fairytale castle guarding the actual crown jewels. Pay to peek at royal loot; the Kongens Have lawns outside are free.

name: Freetown Christiania
desc: The self-declared freetown of murals and workshops. Free to wander, wild to explain to your parents. Mind the no-photo zones.

name: Rundetaarn
desc: A 1642 tower climbed by spiral ramp — a king once rode a horse up it. A few bucks for skyline plus smug historical trivia.

name: Torvehallerne
desc: Twin glass halls of smørrebrød and pastry. Free to enter, dangerous to your last hundred kroner.

name: Superkilen
desc: A park striped red and black, furnished with objects from 60 countries. Skate, swing, people-watch — all free.

name: Amalienborg Palace Square
desc: Four palaces around one octagonal square. Catch the changing of the guard at noon for free royal theater.

name: Botanical Garden
desc: Victorian glasshouses and free jungle air downtown. The palm house is the cheapest tropical vacation in Denmark.
